courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Agricultural Engineering
courses.summary: The Students Traffic catalogue category for four-year undergraduate agricultural engineering degrees. Programmes in this category apply engineering to farming and food production: farm machinery and power, soil and water conservation, irrigation and drainage, post-harvest and processing engineering and renewable energy in agriculture, with field and workshop practice. Curriculum, regulator approval, admission route and fees are set by each awarding university, so the programme record should drive a shortlist decision.
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.E./B.Tech Agricultural engineering programmes by curriculum, approvals, admission route, teaching language and fee status before you apply.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Data Science
aliases: Bachelor of Technology in Data Science
courses.summary: Compare undergraduate Data Science degrees abroad by statistics, machine learning, data engineering, applied projects, tuition and admissions. Each university offering keeps its official award title, artificial-intelligence specialisation depth and entry requirements visible before applying.
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.E./B.Tech Data Science programmes abroad by curriculum, tuition fees, admissions and practical training.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Biotechnology
courses.summary: The B.E./B.Tech in Biotechnology is an undergraduate engineering degree that applies engineering principles to living systems. Students study biochemistry, microbiology, molecular biology and genetic engineering alongside bioprocess engineering, fermentation technology, downstream processing, bioinformatics and engineering mathematics, with substantial laboratory work and an industry or research project. It is usually a four-year programme entered after secondary school with physics, chemistry and mathematics or biology. Graduates work in biopharmaceutical, food, agricultural and environmental biotechnology or continue to M.Tech or research study.
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.E./B.Tech Biotechnology degrees open to international students: curriculum, entry subjects, duration, tuition and intakes.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering
aliases: Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science
Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science and Engineering
Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering
courses.summary: This catalogue category covers undergraduate engineering degrees in computer science and engineering, usually four years after an upper-secondary qualification with mathematics. Typical curricula run from programming, data structures, operating systems, databases and computer networks to algorithms, software engineering and electives in artificial intelligence, machine learning, cloud and security, with project and internship components.
courses.metaTitle: B.E./B.Tech CSE Degrees for International Students
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.E./B.Tech CSE degrees for international applicants: duration, teaching language, intake months, tuition and each university's admission route.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
aliases: Bachelor of Electrical and Electronic Engineering
courses.summary: This catalogue category covers four-year undergraduate degrees in electrical and electronics engineering taken after an upper-secondary qualification with physics and mathematics. Programmes typically cover circuit theory, electrical machines, power systems, power electronics, control systems and embedded electronics, with laboratory work and electives in renewable energy or electric mobility.
courses.metaTitle: B.E./B.Tech EEE Degrees for International Students
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.E./B.Tech EEE degrees for international applicants: programme length, teaching language, intake months, tuition and admission routes.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Electronics and Communication Engineering
aliases: Bachelor of Electronics and Communication Engineering
courses.summary: This catalogue category covers undergraduate engineering degrees in electronics and communication engineering, usually four years after upper-secondary physics, chemistry and mathematics. Curricula typically span circuit and network theory, analog and digital electronics, signals and systems, digital signal processing, communication systems and embedded or VLSI design, with laboratory and project work.
courses.metaTitle: B.E./B.Tech ECE Degrees for International Students
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.E./B.Tech ECE degrees for international applicants: duration, teaching language, intakes, tuition and each university's admission route.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering
courses.summary: The B.E./B.Tech in Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering is a undergraduate degree in electronics and instrumentation engineering. It usually lasts four years and combines foundation courses in mathematics and science with discipline-specific theory, laboratory work, industrial training and a final-year project. Compare each university's official award title, entry requirements, tuition and intake before applying, because specialisations and admission routes vary by institution.
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.E./B.Tech Instrumentation programmes by university, eligibility, admission route, duration and tuition fees for domestic and international applicants.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Information Technology
aliases: Bachelor of Engineering in Information Technology
courses.summary: An approved Engineering catalogue category for four-year undergraduate information technology degrees, including university programmes that publish Computer Science as a major within an Information Technology award. The exact university title and major structure remain visible on each offering.
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.E./B.Tech IT programmes, official titles, fees, duration and admissions routes for international students.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
courses.summary: A four-year undergraduate engineering degree covering engineering mechanics, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, machine design, manufacturing processes and control systems. Teaching is built around workshop practice, thermal and materials laboratories, computer-aided design and a final-year project. Graduates move into manufacturing, automotive, energy, thermal and design roles, or continue to a master's specialisation such as thermal engineering or machine design.
courses.metaTitle: B.E./B.Tech Mechanical: Course, Fees and Admission
courses.metaDescription: What a four-year B.E./B.Tech Mechanical degree covers, its entry requirements, how admission is decided and what tuition and duration to plan for.

courses.summary: Compare mechatronics engineering degrees abroad by official award, mechanical and electrical systems, controls, robotics, design projects, practical training, tuition and admission requirements. Review each programme's laboratories and co-op structure.
courses.metaDescription: Compare B.E./B.Tech Mechatronics programmes abroad by university, robotics curriculum, tuition fees, practical training and admissions.

universities.name: Bannari Amman Institute of Technology
universities.summary: Bannari Amman Institute of Technology is a private autonomous engineering college in Sathyamangalam, Tamil Nadu. Its taught portfolio covers engineering and technology at undergraduate and postgraduate levels, alongside an MBA. The campus provides laboratories, a learning centre, residential accommodation and medical services, with Anna University affiliation.
universities.campusLifestyle: The campus includes academic buildings, a learning centre, laboratories, Wi-Fi, a cafeteria and a cooperative store. Laundry, ATMs and reverse-osmosis water facilities support day-to-day campus living.
universities.cityProfile: The teaching campus is on the Sathy–Bhavani State Highway at Alathukombai, Sathyamangalam, in Erode district, Tamil Nadu 638401. Sathyamangalam is the canonical town; Erode is the district rather than a substitute campus city. TNEA counselling identifies the college with code 2702.
universities.practicalExposure: Undergraduate Regulations 2026 include laboratory work, projects, employability-enhancement activities and industry-oriented courses. The MBA curriculum includes a four-week summer internship and a final-semester project. The ME curriculum includes dissertation phases in the third and fourth semesters. These academic components do not guarantee an internship placement or employment.
universities.hostelOverview: Separate men’s and women’s hostels provide single, double and four-person room options. Hostel dining halls, kitchens and storage facilities are available. Room allocation and current hostel and mess charges require a separate accommodation budget.
universities.dietarySupport: Hostel dining halls and a campus cafeteria provide meal facilities. The verified information does not specify allergy provision or every dietary option; these requirements should be discussed before accepting accommodation.
universities.safetyOverview: The campus medical centre has resident medical officers, nursing staff and a round-the-clock emergency ambulance service for access to hospitals in Sathyamangalam, Coimbatore or Erode.
universities.studentSupport: Undergraduate students are assigned a faculty mentor for course registration, academic progression and academic planning. Students Traffic can help compare the admission route, branch and full-cost plan.
whyChoose: Engineering and technology branches with a separate MBA pathway.
Laboratory and project components across the taught curricula.
Residential accommodation and a campus medical centre.

Hostel, mess and tuition need a category-specific full-cost budget.

faq.question: Is Bannari Amman Institute of Technology a university?
faq.answer: It is an autonomous engineering college affiliated to Anna University. Its UGC-DTBU webpage contains documents submitted for a deemed-to-be-university application; that is not proof that deemed status has been awarded.

faq.question: Where is Bannari Amman Institute of Technology?
faq.answer: The campus is at Alathukombai on the Sathy–Bhavani State Highway, Sathyamangalam 638401, in Erode district of Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: How long are the regular undergraduate degrees?
faq.answer: The 2026 regulations specify four academic years across eight semesters for regular B.E./B.Tech. entry. Lateral entry has a separate three-year structure and eligibility conditions.

faq.question: What is the undergraduate teaching language?
faq.answer: The 2026 regulations use English for instruction, examinations and other academic activities, except courses specifically approved in Tamil. This does not establish the teaching language of every postgraduate programme.

faq.question: What is the TNEA counselling code?
faq.answer: Bannari Amman Institute of Technology appears in Anna University’s affiliated-college directory with TNEA code 2702 and examination code 7376.

faq.question: What documents are needed after government-quota allotment?
faq.answer: The college lists the provisional allotment order, school mark statements, transfer/conduct certificate, photograph and applicable category and first-graduate records. Medical fitness and an Aadhaar copy appear in its domestic joining checklist.

faq.question: Are campus hostels available?
faq.answer: Separate men’s and women’s hostels offer different room occupancies and dining facilities. Hostel charges and room allocation are separate decisions from an academic offer.

faq.question: Does the MBA include practical work?
faq.answer: The MBA regulations specify a four-week summer internship between the second and third semesters and project work in the fourth semester. Participation does not guarantee an employer placement.

faq.question: Are fees the same for every applicant?
faq.answer: The institutional fee table distinguishes government and management quotas and programme accreditation categories. A full-cost plan must also separate academic charges, accommodation and meals; the available table does not establish a tuition-only annual figure for each exact branch and category.

faq.question: Are honours and minor pathways separate admissions?
faq.answer: The 2026 undergraduate rules provide honours and minor study within the curriculum. They are not separate first-entry programme offers.

fee.notes: The 2026–27 institutional fee table distinguishes entry quota and NBA status, but does not isolate annual tuition for this exact branch and category. A current fee and full-cost plan is required; no annual amount or currency conversion is inferred.

admissionsContent.overview: B.E. Mechatronics Engineering follows the regular four-year, eight-semester undergraduate structure.

eligibility.intro: Academic-stream TNEA government-quota entry is distinct from management, overseas and lateral-entry routes.
items: Pass HSC Academic(+1 and+2) or accepted equivalent with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry.
Minimum PCM average is 45% for General and 40% for the specified Tamil Nadu reserved categories under TNEA 2026.
Applicable TNEA schooling, nativity and category conditions must be satisfied; minimum eligibility does not guarantee allotment.

applicationSteps: Register for the notified TNEA cycle and submit academic and route-specific records.
Follow rank, branch-choice and allotment instructions for college code 2702; complete the college’s joining checklist after allotment.

application: Provisional allotment order and passport photograph
Applicable community, first-graduate and government-school proof
Physical-fitness certificate and Aadhaar copy for the documented domestic route

admissionsContent.deadlinesNote: The eligibility record is for TNEA 2026, not a declaration that applications are currently open. No future intake date or application deadline is asserted.

eligibleAudiences: Applicants meeting TNEA 2026 academic-stream government-quota conditions
restrictions: Only the documented regular first-year academic-stream government-quota route is represented; management, foreign/NRI and lateral entry are not assessed here.
TNEA schooling, nativity, community and applicant-category conditions apply. These 2026 rules do not establish a future-cycle admission offer.
audienceEligibility.notes: This candidate records only the evidenced TNEA 2026 academic-stream government-quota route. It does not establish a foreign/NRI or management-quota route, or availability of seats after the 2026 counselling cycle.

evidence.claimText: The campus includes academic buildings, a learning centre, laboratories, Wi-Fi, a cafeteria and a cooperative store. Laundry, ATMs and reverse-osmosis water facilities support day-to-day campus living.
BIT identifies its campus at Alathukombai, Sathyamangalam 638401, Erode District, Tamil Nadu.
evidence.internalNotes: The highway description is separately supported by the mandatory disclosure; counselling code is separately supported by the Anna register.

evidence.claimText: Undergraduate Regulations 2026 include laboratory work, projects, employability-enhancement activities and industry-oriented courses.
evidence.internalNotes: MBA internship and ME dissertation components are supported by separate evidence entries; no placement guarantee is asserted.

evidence.claimText: Separate men’s and women’s hostels provide single, double and four-person room options. Hostel dining halls, kitchens and storage facilities are available. Room allocation and current hostel and mess charges require a separate accommodation budget.

Hostel dining halls and a campus cafeteria provide meal facilities. The verified information does not specify allergy provision or every dietary option; these requirements should be discussed before accepting accommodation.
The campus medical centre has resident medical officers, nursing staff and a round-the-clock emergency ambulance service for access to hospitals in Sathyamangalam, Coimbatore or Erode.
Undergraduate Regulations 2026 assign faculty mentors to support course registration, academic progression and academic planning.
evidence.internalNotes: The Students Traffic cost/admission-support sentence is a service CTA, not an institutional service or a claim sourced to BIT.

evidence.claimText: Anna University lists Bannari Amman Institute of Technology (Autonomous) with TNEA 2702 and examination code 7376.
The UGC-DTBU page is an application-document collection, not an approval conferring deemed-to-be-university status.
MBA regulations specify a four-week summer internship and final-semester project.
ME programmes include third- and fourth-semester dissertation phases.

Do not simplify it to all Indian applicants, all international applicants, or a Tamil Nadu domicile-only rule. Complete international-status assessment remains held.

evidence.sourceLabel: TNEA 2026 information brochure, application and counselling process
evidence.claimText: TNEA uses online application, document verification, ranking, college/branch choices and allotment for its documented 2026 route.
evidence.internalNotes: Supports the counselling steps only. The separate BIT admissions evidence supports college joining documents. This is not proof that a particular branch currently has seats or that a later cycle is open.
